name: Sei
source:
A friend of Gui. One of the few people that Cyan could let his guard down.
Though Sei usually teases Cyan, he always listens to whatever Cyan has to say.
Sei is knowledgeable and he often tells Cyan about interesting things froms places faraway. He however, rarely talks about himself.
